name: Sucheta
reason: Good Sanskrit name (su + cetas); IAST and Devanagari agree.

name: Kanakadurga
reason: Established Andhra name after Kanaka Durga of Vijayawada; scripts agree.

name: Rudrama
reason: Regional Telugu form (cf. Rudramadevi); 'Rudra's consort' gloss is weak; scripts agree.

fix.name: Rudrama
fix.meaning_en: Telugu regional form associated with Rudrāmbā, a name of the Mother Goddess; borne by Queen Rudrama Devi (etymology of the ending uncertain)

name: Subbulakshmi
reason: IAST (subbalakṣmī) and Devanagari (सुब्बलक्ष्मी) disagree with spelling Subbulakshmi; 'subba = auspicious' is unsupported.

fix.name: Subbulakshmi
fix.meaning_en: Lakshmi, goddess of prosperity; 'Subbu' is a regional Tamil/Telugu prefix, etymology uncertain
